It\'s your circle of friends. And a circle closes: when you\'ve seen everyone\'s day, the circle is closed, and you\'re done. (That\'s why the name ends with a full stop.)

I built Circle because the apps I used to love for keeping up with friends turned into endless scrolling. I wanted a place where I open the app, see what my friends are up to, and close it again. No tricks to keep me there.
If you want a bigger circle, make an event, go outside and meet someone. Then come back and tell your friends about it.
